title: Ward-spectral positive-functional scale fiber

classification.faithfulness: at a fixed common spectral scale and fixed alpha, the functional sees the neutral completion
classification.scale_fiber: independent positive rescaling of D preserves irreducibility and can equalize scores
classification.weight_fiber: alpha is an inverse-square clock; simultaneous D and alpha rescaling leaves the score invariant
classification.minimizer: the quadratic spectral penalty has an unattained zero-scale infimum on irreducible positive-scale packets
classification.selector_or_rigidifier: a source-fixed common clock makes F a comparison functional; without it F is a scale rigidifier, not a spectrum selector
classification.physical_instrument: no admitted experiment measures the combined Ward and finite-Dirac score with one calibrated relative metric

smallest_exact_falsifier: the base at scale 1 and neutral completion at scale 3/sqrt(22) have identical F_alpha for every alpha>0
remaining_source_gate: derive the charged-neutral relative metric and absolute spectral clock from one action, prove its minimizer exists and is unique over all physical completions, then transport that minimizer through RG, thresholds, and a common instrument

tests.name: relative_weight_and_spectral_units_have_common_rescaling_fiber
tests.evidence:
(Matrix([
[    0, clock,       0,   clock],
[clock, clock,   clock,       0],
[    0, clock, 2*clock,   clock],
[clock,     0,   clock, 3*clock]]), alpha/clock**2)
